depth_justification: Questions are tied to PainTrack's actual features (FHIR-EHR integration accuracy, tamper-proof PDF transmission, free-text trigger and body-map misinterpretation, mood-entry bias), but it cites no regulation, mildly loops while the user re-pastes the same data list, and ignores the developer's explicit invitation to 'sketch what good would look like' instead of engaging.
actionability_justification: Entirely interrogative with zero recommendations, it skips the developer's direct request for a sketch, and the requested report is just seven one-line risk restatements with no mitigations and no real severity grouping, so nothing is implementable.
salient_examples: USER: Good question — we haven't pinned that down yet. Happy to think through it ... if you can sketch what 'good' would look like.
